script_text: Stop, Pisces—the sky is pressing reset on your nervous system. As a water sign ruled by Neptune, you feel the Sun in Gemini squaring Saturn in your 1st House: home duties, body tension, and a boundary are colliding. Uranus in Gemini is squaring Saturn from your 4th House, so one family text, repair quote, or move-related detail can jolt your routine. Mars in Libra is in your 8th House, trining that Sun, making intimacy, shared money, taxes, or a private agreement easier to confront than avoid. If taken, talk logistics before desire; if single, a magnetic person appears through a friend, debt, or late-night message. Neptune in Aries is in your 2nd House of money, so get any rate, invoice, commission, or creative fee in writing before noon. Avoid signing a lease, loan, or emotional ultimatum under Saturn pressure; the details are still moving. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
